description: Reference tuning and its drift (TuningFrequency on spectral peaks), key and scale (Key) and chords (ChordsDetection) from frames/hpcp, and sensory dissonance, by Essentia. Decodes again for spectral peaks, which the bank does not hold.

pitched.description: 1 where the frame sounds and its five-second block's spectral peaks agree on a tuning; 0 for silence, talk, and noise

tuning_frequency.description: the frequency of A4 the pitched frames are tuned to; 440.0 with confidence 0 when no frame is pitched

tuning_cents.description: the tuning's distance from 440 Hz, in [-50, 50)

tuning_confidence.description: share of the sounding frames' peak magnitude within 15 cents of the tuning; 0 when no frame is pitched, about 0.31 for noise

tuning_windows.description: every window of about 20 s every 10 s: its tuning in cents near tuning_cents (0 when it has no pitched frame), the confidence of that tuning over its sounding frames, and its share of pitched frames

tuning_drift.description: the tuning windows that are at least half pitched; value: the window's tuning in cents from 440 Hz, near tuning_cents

drift_spread_cents.description: tenth to ninetieth percentile of tuning_drift's values; 0 for fewer than two windows

key.description: tonic of the pitched frames' mean profile, as Essentia names notes (A, Bb, B, C, C#, D, Eb, E, F, F#, G, Ab); empty when no frame is pitched

scale.description: major or minor; empty when no frame is pitched

key_strength.description: Key's strength; 0 when no frame is pitched

keys.description: windows of about 30 s every 15 s that are at least half pitched; label: key and scale; value: strength

chords.description: runs of one chord over pitched frames; label: Essentia's chord name; value: mean strength

chords_changes_rate.description: ChordsDescriptors' changes rate over the pitched frames; 0 when none

chords_number_rate.description: ChordsDescriptors' number rate over the pitched frames; 0 when none

dissonance.description: sensory dissonance of each frame's peaks within 40 dB of its loudest, 0 to 0.5; 0 for a frame with no peaks
